the process of Semantic Analysis can be used as a tool to aid the development of class diagrams.

the development of a methodology for the design of a UML class diagram from a semantic representation.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a semantic analysis can be useful to aid the design of a system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to provide a set of guidelines that can be applied by the analyst in order to produce a class diagram, which can be used as a starting point in the process of designing a software system.
the process for constructing class diagrams can be aided by the use of Semantic Analysis.
we are proposing a method that allows a group of people with different backgrounds to reach a common ground on the design of a class diagram, which can be used to generate a system design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the process of building an ontology chart and the process of building a class diagram are two sides of the same coin.
, by using Semantic Analysis, the process of building a class diagram is facilitated and the quality of the resulting diagram is enhanced.
, when using the Ontology Chart as a starting point, the UML class diagram is a good representation of the semantic analysis, and can be used as a first approximation to the system design.
